versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Added CLI script (`scripts/cli.mjs`) to enable command-line querying of wallet address info.
- Added a CLI usage reference (`references/cli.md`) with command and parameter details.
- Removed old skill summary doc (`skill-card.md`).
- Expanded SKILL.md to include new CLI usage, supported chains, and detailed command documentation.

- Initial release of the Query Address Info skill.
- Enables querying any wallet address for on-chain token balances and positions across supported chains (BSC, Base, Solana).
- Returns token details including name, symbol, price, 24h price change, and holding quantity.
- Supports pagination via the offset parameter.
- Documentation includes API example and details about request/response formats.
